title: Solutis Tecnologias
description: solutis.com.br Revenue $53 Million Solutis Tecnologias is a Brazilian IT integration company founded in 2010, now headquartered in São Paulo with over 1,200 employees across 5 countries. It specializes in AI, digital transformation, Salesforce, FICO and cloud solutions for financial services, utilities and public sector clients like Sabesp, Furnas, Serasa and Banco Rendimento. In September 2026 it launched SOL.AI, a proprietary AI platform with 6 solution domains covering agentic software engineering, data pipelines, enterprise AI governance and regulatory readiness. Led by CEO Paulo Marcelo since 2019, revenue grew from R$100 million to R$140 million in 2022 with a target of R$300 million by 2027. Strategic partnerships include Salesforce, AWS, Microsoft, Databricks and Elastic. Its own AI Center and Studio.AI development platform power client delivery.
